Experienced HR Truck Drivers for road and asphalt projects. LAHA, accommodation, paid travel and ongoing work   Your new company  
 Our client is a leading civil infrastructure contractor delivering road construction, maintenance, and asphalt projects throughout Queensland. With a strong pipeline of ongoing work and a commitment to safety and quality, they are seeking experienced HR Truck Drivers to join their growing team. 
  Your new role  
 As an HR Truck Driver, you will be responsible for operating heavy vehicles to support road construction, maintenance, and asphalt projects across regional Queensland. This position involves both local and away work, with employees typically working away for up to two weeks at a time. 
 You will transport materials, equipment, and plant between project locations while also assisting crews with general site duties when required. Travel time is paid from the moment you leave Mackay, and a company vehicle is provided from depot to depot. A daily Living Away From Home Allowance (LAHA) is paid while working away, with accommodation supplied throughout the duration of the project. Successful candidates must pass a pre-employment Drug & Alcohol test prior to commencing work. Smoking is not permitted on site and all employees must adhere to the client's strict health, safety, and workplace policies 
  What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Current HR Driver's Licence 
 Current White Card 
 Previous experience working on civil, road construction, or asphalt projects 
 Strong understanding of safe vehicle operation and site safety requirements 
 Ability to assist crews with labouring duties when required 
 Reliable and committed to project deadlines 
 Ability to work away from home for up to two weeks at a time 
 Current Driver's Licence and reliable transport 
 Ability to pass a pre-employment Medical and Drug & Alcohol Screening 
 Contactable work references 
 
  What you'll get in return  
 This is an excellent opportunity to secure ongoing work with a respected civil contractor offering long-term career opportunities. You'll receive competitive pay rates, daily Living Away From Home Allowance (LAHA), accommodation while working away, paid travel time from Mackay, and transport in a company vehicle from depot to depot. For the right candidate, there is also the opportunity to transition from a temporary position into a permanent role. 
  What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. If you have any further questions, please contact Zoe Ingram (07) 4960 1128. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
PERM Opportunity to drive enterprise-wide ITSM excellence and service improvement within high-profile Fed Gov   Your new company     Join a high-profile federal government department that delivers critical services both domestically and internationally. Working within a large and complex ICT environment, you will be part of a team focused on enhancing service management capability, improving user experience, and driving continuous service improvement across the organisation. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to enterprise-wide ICT initiatives while working in a collaborative and outcomes-driven environment.    Your new role     
 As an APS6 ITSM Enablement Specialist, you will play a key role in strengthening and maturing IT Service Management (ITSM) practices across the organisation. Acting as the bridge between people, process, and technology, you will help optimise the enterprise ITSM platform, improve service delivery processes, and drive the adoption of best-practice ITIL-aligned frameworks. 
 You will work closely with ICT teams, business stakeholders, and service providers to configure and enhance ITSM tools, develop policies and procedures, support governance activities, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys improving operational efficiency, influencing service management outcomes, and enabling teams to deliver exceptional customer-focused services. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Demonstrated experience in IT Service Management (ITSM) operations and service delivery environments 
 Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks and service management best practices 
 Experience configuring, maintaining, or optimising ITSM platforms and workflows 
 Ability to develop and improve policies, processes, standards, and supporting documentation 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills 
 Experience analysing business processes and identifying improvement opportunities 
 Excellent problem-solving, communication, and analytical skills 
 Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment 
 NV1 Security Clearance (mandatory) 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 12-month non-ongoing opportunity with a 6-month extension option and potential for ongoing employment 
 Opportunity to work in a high-profile federal government ICT environment 
 Exposure to enterprise-scale ITSM platforms, governance frameworks, and service improvement initiatives 
 Hybrid working arrangements based in the ACT 
 Work alongside experienced ICT professionals and key business stakeholders 
 The ability to influence and improve service management practices across a large and complex organisation 
 A collaborative and supportive team environment focused on innovation, service excellence, and continuous improvement 
 
  What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call me now on 02 6112 7695 or email Aanchal.Dwivedi@hays.com.au. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact me for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.
